_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Do not work for the bread that perishes.
Give us the bread that lasts to eternal life.
I am the bread of life, says the Lord.
Whoever comes to him will never hunger again.
Create in us a clean heart, O God.
Renew a right spirit within us.
Come, all who hunger; come, let us worship.
We come to the bread of life. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: The crowd hunts him down the next morning, still tasting yesterday's bread, and he says: do not work for food that spoils.
Give us this bread always.
What our ancestors ate in the wilderness kept them one more day; this bread comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.
Give us this bread always.
I am the bread of life, he says; whoever comes to me will never be hungry, whoever believes will never be thirsty again.
Give us this bread always.
So bring the hunger underneath your hunger, the thirst no cup has touched; here is the One your soul was made for.
Give us this bread always.
